TO: MR
FROM:
DATE: 21ST JUNE 2000
INTRODUCTION:

As requested, the aim of this report is to assess the
suitbility
for a group of American students
for
the visit
at
the Etruscan Museum.
GENERAL INFORMATION:

The museum is situated in the centre of Populoniou, the picturesque fishing village on the Etruscan Coast. Populoniou is about 15 Km. from Piombino and it can be reached by
well-organised
means of transport.
DESCRIPTION:

The Etruscan Museum is one of the most attractive
building
in my town. It contains lots of
archeological
Etruscans founded
and some remains
about
Etruscans
neoropolis
.

The entrance fee is £7
each student.
POSITIVE ASPECTS

1. The Museum is
well-organised
for tourists. There are some shops,
café and toilets. Also there are some free
handphones
,
that explain the history of the museum.

2. After their visit
into
the Museum, they could enjoy the superb view of the sea and the
tuscan
Archipelago, and they could have a
pic-nic
on the beach.
NEGATIVE ASPECTS

1. The negative aspect of the museum is that
is quite expensive for students.
CONCLUSION:

Although the entrance fee is quite expensive for a group of students, I strongly
reccomend

their interests.
